request: The study combines several seedling samples and asks for a result that differs between individuals. In discussions, the authors have used the words regulation, activity, and personalized network interchangeably, and that has made the planned deliverable unclear. The expression matrix and both biological priors have already passed the file checks, so requesting another file will not settle the issue. Before recommending an execution path, we need to identify what numerical object the authors intend to compare across the individual samples. Please keep the unresolved scientific endpoint visible rather than silently selecting one interpretation. Can GIRAFFE meet the requirement for an individual result in our beet-root paper? The authors have not decided whether individual means TF activity per sample or a different regulatory wiring matrix per sample.
